snippet.title: Luduvo's First Game Jam: Results
snippet.description:
The results for our first ever game jam are in. After careful consideration, we present to you the top ten submissions for the Unfinished Luduvo Alpha Jam!

Welcome to the Luduvo universe! Luduvo is a community-driven UGC platform innovating and changing on how people can build, share, and explore their own interactive worlds. Join the fun for free: https://luduvo.com

Catch us here! 👋
https://instagram.com/luduvoapp
https://tiktok.com/@luduvoapp
https://x.com/luduvoapp
https://discord.gg/Luduvo
